title_original: Doha Film Festival awards prizes worth over $300,000 at second edition
excerpt_original: Seven prizes awarded to international feature film competition including best narrative.

blocks.text: Zou Jing’s Chinese coming-of-age story A Girl Unknown and Qatari feature Jodari Meno headed the winners at the 2026 Doha Film Festival (DFF), with over $300,000 worth of prizes given out.

A Girl Unknown received the $75,000 best narrative award in the international feature film competition. The film, which premiered at Critics’ Week in Cannes this year, follows a Chinese woman from the age of six into her 30s, and looks at the trauma of abandoned children in the country. It was selected by a jury headed by Japanese filmmaker Naomi Kawase.

blocks.text: Jamal Rashid Alkhanji’s Qatari feature Jodari Meno received the audience award. Playing in the special screenings section, the documentary follows Qatari filmmaker Alkhanji’s quest to land a dogtooth tuna; what begins as an extreme pursuit becomes an obsession linked to the search for meaning. It is backed by Qatari film organisations including the Doha Film Institute and Media City Qatar.

The late Josette Kwanya won best performance in the international competition for her role in House Of The Wind , directed by her son Auguste Bernard Kouemo Yanghu. Kwanya passed away in 2024, four months after filming was completed on the feature.

Rafael Manuel’s Film4-backed UK-Filipino feature Filipiñana took the $45,000 best artistic achievement in narrative award. The film’s breakout star Jorrybell Agoto died earlier this month , aged 32, after battling blood cancer.

“The films we honour tonight remind us that cinema is not simply a reflection of the world we live in; it is a force that can shape how we understand it, connect with one another and imagine a more empathetic future,” said Fatma Hassan Alremaihi, DFF director and Doha Film Institute (DFI) CEO.
The ceremony took place at the Katara Cultural Village, hosted by Sudanese filmmaker and presenter Amjad Al-Nour. Guests included DFI chairperson Sheikha Al-Mayassa bint Hamad bin Khalifa Al Thani.

Best narrative – A Girl Unknown , dir. Zou Jing Special mention – 9 Temples To Heaven , dir. Sompot Chidgasornpongse Best performance – Josette Kwanya for House Of The Wind Best artistic achievement in documentary – Bardi , dir. Tala Hadid Best artistic achievement in narrative – Filipiñana , dir. Rafael Manuel Best documentary – Concrete Land , dir. Asmahan Bkerat Fipresci prize – Concrete Land , dir. Asmahan Bkerat
Ajyal film competition best feature – We Are Aliens , dir. Kohei Kadowaki
Audience award – Jodari Meno , dir. Jamal Rashid Alkhanji
